cards.subtitle: A wood-slat ink band seamed top and bottom with a glowing amber light-strip. One or two per page, never more.
cards.name: The dark beat · slat + light-strip

cards.subtitle: A card means a distinct OBJECT. Lists and rail sections group with a title and whitespace — not a box each.
cards.name: Group, don't box

cards.subtitle: The catalogued photography, sorted by the job each frame does. Toggle the hero treatment, captions and density to see how a frame behaves before you place it.
cards.name: Imagery · the library

cards.subtitle: Rounded-geometric wordmark with the Community Collective lockup. Dark on light, warm cream on ink, and engraved as chrome.
cards.name: Wordmark

cards.subtitle: Flat, warm, FILLED shapes in the DAWN palette. Amber led, teal accent, big rounded corners, one focal point. Never thin line-art, gradients, 3D, or realistic anatomy.
cards.name: Loom · illustration language

cards.subtitle: One cadence for every public page: PhotoHero, lead, alternating beats, proof, the ink statement, the beta close. Adjacent sections never repeat a tone.
cards.name: Marketing page spine

cards.subtitle: Building an in-app page is two decisions: pick the template by what the content is, then register its chrome. The same header, content, rail grammar repeats inside a Detail page at smaller scale.
cards.name: One shell, five templates

cards.subtitle: A camp counselor you actually respect. Proper nouns carry the magic, sentences stay plain. Every word in a design passes the skeptic test.
cards.name: Voice · the law

cards.subtitle: Button · Badge · RankBadge · Avatar · IconButton · Stat · Card · BrandMark
cards.name: Core

cards.subtitle: EmptyState (warm, points to a human action) · Toast (Quest awards, slide-up)
cards.name: Feedback

cards.subtitle: Input · Textarea · Select · Checkbox · Switch — calm neutral focus, amber controls
cards.name: Forms

cards.subtitle: Every number a member sees. Mono, tabular, small on purpose: three shapes, four sizes, and a streak that never shames anyone.
cards.name: Counters & streaks

cards.subtitle: Compose pages from these, never re-declare them: PageHeading, UnderlineTabs, SectionHeader, EntityCard, RowCard, PersonCard, StatCard, ProgressTrack.

cards.subtitle: Tabs — the in-app DetailTemplate row, underline style with an amber active marker
cards.name: Navigation

cards.subtitle: Deep warm near-black from Frequency's wood-slat interiors. The cinematic beat — one or two per page, never more.
cards.name: Ink · the dark band

cards.subtitle: A skin is a token override on data-skin, orthogonal to light/dark mode. DAWN light, DAWN dark, Midnight light, Midnight dark. Midnight keeps the amber and sharpens the radii.
cards.name: Midnight skin · four render states

cards.subtitle: Cerulean for the Mindless movement door. Deliberately bluer than Signal and success so it never reads as done.
cards.name: Move · the Get Moving accent

cards.subtitle: Warm cream canvas, white content, chrome a step down, soft warm charcoal ink. No cold grey anywhere.
cards.name: Neutrals · surfaces, chrome, borders & text

cards.subtitle: The single chrome accent: every CTA, glow and active state. Four steps, each with one job.
cards.name: Primary · Amber-gold

cards.subtitle: Ten earthy primitives, each with core / deep / bright variants. The four season ranks draw from the first four; the rest serve Pillars, Amplitude tiers and Space accents.
cards.name: Rank spectrum · The Quest

cards.subtitle: Success is a TEAL, not a green. Four states, each with a tint, and a rule about when to reach for them at all.
cards.name: Semantic states

cards.subtitle: Two restricted hues. Signal is the rare jewel-teal secondary; Broadcast is comms only, never general chrome.
cards.name: Signal & Broadcast

cards.subtitle: The settled effects system: three elevations, four lights, four textures, three shapes. One texture per band, one lift-3 per page.
cards.name: Texture, light & lift

cards.subtitle: The non-color half of the look. Radius by role (what a skin retunes), three motion durations, and the one density root every rem derives from.
cards.name: Feel · radius, motion, density

cards.subtitle: Every animation in the system, live. cue-pop is the base beat; the rest are signatures. All of it stops under prefers-reduced-motion.
cards.name: Motion inventory

cards.subtitle: Warm near-espresso shadows over hard borders. In-app rests at sm and lifts to md; marketing gets the pop steps.
cards.name: Elevation · soft warm depth

cards.subtitle: Role decides radius, not preference. Three role tokens are the skin contract; the step scale serves everything else.
cards.name: Radius · by role

cards.subtitle: One ramp, three in-app rhythms, one marketing heartbeat. Space is the layout tool — reach for it before a border.
cards.name: Spacing scale & rhythm

cards.subtitle: Rounded, friendly body and in-app heading face. Headings sit at 700 with negative tracking — never 800.
cards.name: Body · Nunito

cards.subtitle: Heavy condensed editorial face. Marketing headlines and big numerals, always uppercase, always tight.
cards.name: Display · Anton

cards.subtitle: Eyebrow tracking is locked. Accent one keyword per heading; the italic kicker is the deck under it.
cards.name: Eyebrow & kicker

cards.subtitle: Code, tokens, and tabular UI — counts, currencies, timestamps
cards.name: Mono · Geist Mono

cards.subtitle: Every size is a role with a job. Never set a heading size ad hoc; never take content below the meta floor.
cards.name: Type scale · roles, not pixels

cards.subtitle: Top right is the system, bottom left is you and what you run, bottom right is the Vault (member) or this page (operator). Nothing is offered twice.
cards.name: The three docks · law of place

cards.subtitle: One flow, two mounts: a modal over any page, or the same steps inline on a full page. Starts on describe-or-upload with a directions box and basic settings, then source, shape, schedule, review.

cards.subtitle: Curated Lucide glyphs for the game: currencies, showing up, quest structure, rewards. Amber chip treatment; ranks in the rank spectrum.

cards.subtitle: Achievement medals for completing challenges. Icon-forward (distinct from rank coins) + a currency chip paid in-kind: zaps for real-world, gems for online.
